title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of P84.8M Superlotto 6/49 jackpot on Thursday Nov. 5, 2026
summary: There were no winners of the Superlotto prize of over P87.8 million after no winners were announced in the major lotto jackpot draws on Thursday, November 5, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes…

blocks.text: There were no winners of the Superlotto 6/49 prize of over P87.8 million after no winners were announced in the major lotto jackpot draws on Thursday, November 5, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said.
The Superlotto 6/49 jackpot of P87,844,738.10 was unclaimed after no one used winning number combination of 10-46-40-39-04-16.
No one was able to guess the Lotto 6/42 winning combination of 25-38-23-36-34-21, so no one to home the P10,000,000 prize.
Check here for the complete lotto results. — BAP, GMA News
